first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: At frame 0 of this clip, Person A is on the left with the upper body leaning forward. The person has short dark hair and wears a blue-gray top with rolled-up sleeves, tan-brown pants, and brown crossed shoulder straps; tracked by clothing and continuous action, with position able to change with the camera view.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The other person who continuously interacts with Person A in this clip. The person has relatively short gray-brown hair and wears a dark crew-neck short-sleeved top and dark pants; the person does not have Person A's crossed shoulder straps and continuously interacts with Person A while holding a sword.

entities.name: Sword A
entities.identification: The sword held by Person A, identified by Person A's grip on it and its continuous motion; a long curved blade and a metal guard near the hand are visible.

entities.name: Sword B
entities.identification: The sword held by Person B, identified by Person B's grip on it and its continuous motion; its designation does not change based on whether it is at the top or bottom of the image or on momentary reflections.

entities.name: Wooden Plank Floor
entities.identification: The continuous wooden plank surface beneath the people's feet and between the two people, with gaps between the planks extending into the distance; it does not include the stairs above, the pillars, or the scattered metal objects.

entities.name: Metal Debris on the Ground
entities.identification: The collection of disc-shaped and irregular small metal objects scattered or piled on the Wooden Plank Floor; individual objects are not numbered, and Sparks from Clashing Swords in the air are not included.

entities.name: Pillar
entities.identification: The thick upright columnar structural elements indoors, visible at the sides and in the background; defined separately from the closely spaced bars of the Grating.

entities.name: Background Wall Rack
entities.identification: The background structure composed of large dark wall surfaces, frame edges, and elevated beam racks behind the people, excluding the separately defined Pillar, Grating, Background Stairs, and Box.

entities.name: Background Stairs
entities.identification: The stairs in the background composed of several horizontal steps that rise progressively, located behind the people and not including ordinary gaps between floorboards.

entities.name: Box
entities.identification: The collection of low rectangular box-shaped containers in the background, with square frames, metal edges, and open or tilted lid surfaces visible; only the regions visible in this clip are counted.

entities.name: Flames
entities.identification: The orange-yellow tongues of fire visible near the Pillar, Background Wall Rack, and background edges; this does not include the white flashes and brief sparks that appear when the swords clash.
